nodes.label: LangGraph search pipeline graph
nodes.rationale: A graph rather than a plain function so steps are explicit, individually testable, observable via LangSmith, and easy to extend.

nodes.label: Conditional LLM edge (llm_enabled)
nodes.rationale: LLM is optional: prescore routes to llm_score only when get_llm returns a model and --no-llm is not set.

nodes.label: No built-in scheduling
nodes.rationale: Owner removed the daily Task Scheduler task because it opened a terminal at every boot; runs are manual.

nodes.label: Unattended /apply mode
nodes.rationale: Nobody can answer in headless runs, so gaps and suggestions go into changes.md instead of questions.

nodes.label: handoff.py per-job brief
nodes.rationale: All instructions live in the brief so the dashboard button, CLI and skill produce the same result.

nodes.label: subscription_env() child environment
nodes.rationale: In -p mode Claude Code uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY whenever present; stripping it and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN keeps runs on the subscription instead of billing the API.

nodes.label: Never pass --bare
nodes.rationale: Bare mode skips subscription login and skill discovery, so /apply would not exist and the API key would be used.

nodes.label: CandidateProfile
nodes.rationale: The profile is the query for the whole system; a wrong profile silently ruins every score.

nodes.label: Heuristic profile fallback
nodes.rationale: Keeps the system usable without an API key and gives tests a deterministic profile.

nodes.label: years_experience extraction rule
nodes.rationale: Classic failure is the LLM inflating years by counting a non-software job or degree, making 3+ year jobs look like a fit.

nodes.label: No-fabrication rule
nodes.rationale: The owner is interviewed on every line; a single invented claim costs more than any keyword gain.

nodes.label: CV Tailoring Agent graph (Phase 8)
nodes.rationale: Separate graph: on-demand for few jobs, different input/output, needs a self-correction loop.

nodes.label: Tailoring kit outputs (changes.md, gaps.md, cover letter)
nodes.norm_label: tailoring kit outputs (changes.md, gaps.md, cover letter)

nodes.label: Structure lock (edit original .docx in place)
nodes.rationale: Regenerating from Markdown/template changes fonts, spacing, tabs and bullets; the owner's original 1-page docx must be preserved.

nodes.label: VERIFY LLM judge prompt
nodes.rationale: A judge is more reliable when it only checks.

nodes.label: Three-layer design architecture (config.toml / tokens+css / components)
nodes.rationale: If a value can live in config.toml it lives there; CSS only for what Streamlit cannot express.

nodes.label: Color has meaning rule
nodes.rationale: Primary = main action/score/selected; green = skills you have; red only for gaps, failures, overdue.

nodes.label: RTL grid via reversed column_order
nodes.rationale: The data grid is a canvas that stays LTR; score-on-the-right is achieved by reversing column_order.

nodes.label: Per-session user/DB selection
nodes.rationale: One Streamlit process serves every session, so the user/DB path is passed explicitly and JOBHUNTER_USER is never set.

nodes.label: Filter -> prescore -> LLM score
nodes.rationale: Cheapest first so the LLM only sees plausible jobs (cost and time).

nodes.label: Scoring calibration rubric
nodes.rationale: Without anchors models cluster everything at 70-85 and ranking becomes useless.

nodes.label: Collector contract (CollectorResult, never raise)
nodes.rationale: One site being down or changing format must not kill the run.

nodes.label: upsert_jobs (protects user fields)
nodes.rationale: Losing 'applied' marks is the worst bug; the owner would stop trusting the tracker.
